Luther Edward Baxter / Gurdy the Clown

A Select Few Have Been Aboard... Now It's Your Turn!

The Road to Hell is Paved with Good Intentions

For the First Time - 3D with Important Stars!

There is no way to quit a fateful love.

How far is a Greek mother willing to go in order to bring her missing son back home?

The uncensored, controversial footage from July 2010.

Being different is the main attraction.

Seven men who stood between Rommel's Afrika Korps and ultimate victory

Can love call back the dead?
special appearance in the end as Akash's daughter

Who says the virgin always lives 'til the end?

He works hard, she plays harder.

One stray dog, three owners, comes the love that lasts fur-ever.

The movie was filmed in ideal Triglav National Park in Slovenia.

Doing all the wrong things in all the wrong places.
